info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Auto Insurance Quotes Status-v3-spec
info.description: The Auto Insurance Quotes Status API enables users to retrieve the current status of auto insurance quotes within the system. This endpoint serves as a valuable resource for insurance brokers, agents, and customers seeking to track and monitor the progress of their submitted quotes. By leveraging this API, developers can integrate real-time quote status updates into their applications and facilitate efficient customer service. Users can expect timely insights on quote processing, approval states, and other relevant updates.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of quotes.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the current status of quotes in the system. It provides information on whether quotes are active, pending, or expired, helping users to manage their quotes effectively.
